body.name: Paired response-table compression handle
body.construction: Start from any same-law pair witnessing failure of uniform identification. Replace each finite latent root by its deterministic response-type representation, couple the two observed-law moment systems through their common cell vector, and apply support reduction to the joint vector of observational cells, all macro intervention cells, active-edge contrasts, and normalization coordinates. The target is a pair that preserves the complete common observed law, every macro intervention distribution, strict positivity, prescribed observed alphabets, and both exact active micrographs while bounding each retained latent-root support by \(B(H,d)\).
